A LITTLE ABOUT LUMO

Childhood is full of wonder.
Let’s keep it that way.

LUMO Books is a children’s book brand by Ahmed Othman, based in Duhok, Kurdistan, Iraq. We bring coloring, learning, puzzles, and stories together in one cheerful collection.

Our idea is simple: give children something inviting to open, something interesting to try, and room to make each page their own.

A LITTLE GUIDE FOR GROWN-UPS

Start with what they love.

01

Follow an interest

Dinosaurs, ocean friends, magic maps, or numbers? Pick a subject that makes them curious.

02

Find their pace

Use the age guide as a starting point. Explore together and let your child take their time.

03

Make it their own

A new color, a different idea, another try. Leave room for the discoveries only they can make.

GOOD TO KNOW

A few little answers.

Can I order a book now?

This website currently showcases the LUMO collection. Prices and ordering options are coming soon.

How do I choose the right age?

Use the age filter to find books with a matching age guide. Some adventure titles do not yet have a confirmed age range and are shown under All ages.

Can I download a book here?

This catalogue offers cover previews and book information. Downloadable interiors and purchase links are not currently available.

Who creates LUMO Books?

LUMO Books is a children’s book brand by Ahmed Othman, based in Duhok, Kurdistan, Iraq.
